tools.manualInstall: Install Git for Windows and ensure `git` is available on PATH.
Install Python 3.10 or newer and include the Python launcher.
Install the current Node.js LTS release.
npm is expected to ship with the supported Node.js install.

providers.manualInstall: Run the Ollama pull hook or manually execute `ollama pull llama3.1:8b`, then keep the repo-facing readiness marker and optional local-only runtime manifest under `NIKOF_LLM_MODELS_ROOT\ollama-llama3.1-8b` so bootstrap and startup checks can confirm the machine-local model contract.

notes: Optional machine-local override for the Ollama model tag used by NikoF.
Keep this file local only. Bootstrap and startup checks may reference the path, but git should not track it.

remediation.displayName: Pull the local Ollama baseline model
remediation.successHint: After the pull succeeds, rerun bootstrap so the report can confirm the local model hint path or the live Ollama runtime configuration. If you need a non-default model tag, edit `NIKOF_LLM_MODELS_ROOT\ollama-llama3.1-8b\runtime.json`.
notes: Ollama stores model blobs in its own machine-local cache; NikoF does not copy those blobs into git or into the repo tree.
If you want a repo-visible readiness marker, keep a small `.installed.json` note under NIKOF_LLM_MODELS_ROOT\ollama-llama3.1-8b.
The hook also scaffolds `runtime.json` if it does not already exist so the local model tag can stay machine-specific and outside git.

providers.manualInstall: Bootstrap scaffolds `runtime.json` and `install-plan.json` under `NIKOF_STT_MODELS_ROOT\faster-whisper-medium`. Install or extract the approved Faster-Whisper Medium payload under that local-only root, place a provider-local entrypoint under `NIKOF_PROVIDERS_ROOT\stt\faster-whisper`, and rerun bootstrap so startup checks can confirm both proofs.

notes: Machine-local Faster-Whisper Medium metadata belongs here after you place the approved model payload under NIKOF_STT_MODELS_ROOT\faster-whisper-medium.
Keep this file local only. Bootstrap and startup checks use it as a scaffold marker, not as payload proof.

steps: Download the approved Faster-Whisper Medium files to a machine-local staging directory.
Extract only the model payload under NIKOF_STT_MODELS_ROOT\faster-whisper-medium; do not commit downloaded model files.
Place one accepted provider entrypoint under NIKOF_PROVIDERS_ROOT\stt\faster-whisper.
Update runtime.json with any machine-specific model metadata you need.
Rerun bootstrap so the report and startup checks can confirm the local STT contract.

remediation.displayName: Scaffold the Faster-Whisper Medium local install plan
remediation.successHint: Bootstrap already scaffolds `runtime.json` and `install-plan.json` during a normal run. Use this hook only to re-create them if they were deleted, then place the approved model payload and rerun bootstrap.
notes: Do not commit downloaded STT model payloads.
The provider entrypoint lives under NIKOF_PROVIDERS_ROOT and stays separate from the model files.
The manual hook never downloads vendor payloads; it only re-creates local guidance files under the configured STT models root.

providers.upstream: Project-local adapter wrapper under the configured providers root.
providers.manualInstall: Bootstrap scaffolds the local provider runtime manifest under `NIKOF_PROVIDERS_ROOT\stt\faster-whisper`. Place a provider-local Python entrypoint at `NIKOF_PROVIDERS_ROOT\stt\faster-whisper\transcribe.py` or `main.py`, update the manifest only if you need a non-default entrypoint or Python executable, and rerun bootstrap so startup checks can confirm the provider proof.

notes: Optional machine-local adapter overrides for Faster-Whisper invocation.
Set python_executable only when Faster-Whisper must run from a separate local environment.
Entrypoint paths must stay within NIKOF_PROVIDERS_ROOT\stt\faster-whisper.

remediation.successHint: Bootstrap already scaffolds `runtime.json` during a normal run. Use this hook only to re-create the local manifest if it was deleted, then place one provider entrypoint file there and rerun bootstrap.
notes: This is a hook surface, not a vendor download.
Do not commit provider runtime payloads or copied vendor trees.
The manual hook never installs vendor code; it only re-creates a local manifest path that bootstrap and startup guidance can both reference.

providers.manualInstall: Download the Faster-Whisper Small files only if you want the lower-VRAM fallback available on the machine. Reuse the same provider-local entrypoint under `NIKOF_PROVIDERS_ROOT\stt\faster-whisper\` when the backend is not running Faster-Whisper inline.

remediation.successHint: Extract the fallback model so `NIKOF_STT_MODELS_ROOT\faster-whisper-small` exists, then rerun bootstrap.

providers.upstream: Use the project-approved GPT-SoVITS upstream release or fork selected for the environment; do not commit vendor payloads.
providers.manualInstall: Bootstrap scaffolds `runtime.json` and `install-plan.json` under `NIKOF_TTS_MODELS_ROOT\gpt-sovits`. Install or extract the approved GPT-SoVITS payload under that local-only root, keep any voice-specific weights there, and rerun bootstrap so startup checks can confirm the payload proof. The backend-facing provider entrypoint still lives separately under `NIKOF_PROVIDERS_ROOT\tts\gpt-sovits`.

notes: Machine-local GPT-SoVITS model metadata belongs here after you place the vendor payload under NIKOF_TTS_MODELS_ROOT\gpt-sovits.
The current backend adapter does not require these keys yet, but bootstrap and startup guidance treat this file as the canonical model-side local manifest.

acquisition.upstream: Use the project-approved GPT-SoVITS upstream release or fork selected for the environment; do not commit vendor payloads.

steps: Download or clone the approved GPT-SoVITS runtime to a machine-local staging directory.
Extract only the local runtime payload under NIKOF_TTS_MODELS_ROOT\gpt-sovits; do not commit copied vendor trees.
Place speaker checkpoints and reference audio beneath that same local-only tree.
Update runtime.json with any machine-specific speaker metadata you need.
Rerun bootstrap so the report and startup checks can confirm the local contract.

remediation.displayName: Scaffold the GPT-SoVITS local install plan
remediation.successHint: Bootstrap already scaffolds `runtime.json` and `install-plan.json` during a normal run. Use this hook only to re-create them if they were deleted, then place the approved payload and rerun bootstrap.
notes: This repo intentionally does not auto-download GPT-SoVITS vendor payloads.
Keep speaker checkpoints and voice-specific weights in the same local-only tree or a documented subfolder beneath it.
The manual hook never downloads payloads; it only re-creates local guidance files under the configured TTS models root.

providers.upstream: Project-local adapter wrapper under the configured providers root.
providers.manualInstall: Bootstrap scaffolds the local provider runtime manifest under `NIKOF_PROVIDERS_ROOT\tts\gpt-sovits`. Place a provider-local Python entrypoint at `NIKOF_PROVIDERS_ROOT\tts\gpt-sovits\synthesize.py` or `api_server.py`, update the manifest only if you need a non-default entrypoint or Python executable, and rerun bootstrap so startup checks can confirm the provider proof.

notes: Optional machine-local adapter overrides for GPT-SoVITS invocation.
Set python_executable only when GPT-SoVITS must run from a separate local environment.
Entrypoint paths must stay within NIKOF_PROVIDERS_ROOT\tts\gpt-sovits.

remediation.successHint: Bootstrap already scaffolds `runtime.json` during a normal run. Use this hook only to re-create the local manifest if it was deleted, then place one provider entrypoint file there and rerun bootstrap.
notes: This is the safe hook surface for repo-local GPT-SoVITS invocation.
Do not commit provider runtime payloads or copied vendor trees.
The manual hook never installs vendor code; it only re-creates a local manifest path that startup guidance and the backend adapter can both reference.

providers.manualInstall: Download the embedding model files into the embeddings root using the expected folder name.

remediation.successHint: Extract the embedding model so `NIKOF_EMBEDDINGS_ROOT\bge-small-en` exists, then rerun bootstrap.

providers.manualInstall: Add the MiniLM-L6-v2 payload only if you need the lighter fallback path available on the machine.

remediation.successHint: Extract the fallback embedding model so `NIKOF_EMBEDDINGS_ROOT\MiniLM-L6-v2` exists, then rerun bootstrap.

providers.manualInstall: Install Ollama if you plan to run the LLM baseline through it, then keep any machine-local endpoint override or shim in `NIKOF_PROVIDERS_ROOT\llm\ollama\runtime.json` instead of committing it.

notes: Optional machine-local override when Ollama is not running on the default local endpoint.
The backend appends /api/generate automatically.

remediation.successHint: After Ollama is installed, rerun bootstrap and use the pull hook for llama3.1:8b. If you need a non-default endpoint, create or edit `NIKOF_PROVIDERS_ROOT\llm\ollama\runtime.json`.
notes: Bootstrap can point to the installer, but it does not silently install Windows vendor runtimes.
Use a local-only runtime.json under NIKOF_PROVIDERS_ROOT\llm\ollama instead of adding new repo-tracked settings for endpoint overrides.
